prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Draw ONE complete POMNI IN THE JAX SUIT in the approved reference's exact 2D game design. Keep the white face, brown bob/forehead locks, red-and-blue pinwheel irises and orange cheeks, pale lavender rabbit hood with two long rounded ears and small yellow/black eye motifs, lavender covered limbs, yellow gloves, pink short overalls with EXACTLY TWO yellow buttons and ONE bib pocket, and two broad lavender rabbit feet with toe seams. Preserve the reference's proportions, clean dark outlines, colors and detailed cel shading. The small grey toy prop revolver with black grip stays in her anatomical RIGHT glove, lowered or tucked close to the hip, with no firing, flash or projectile. The other glove is empty. No jester hat, bells, ordinary Jax face, new costume piece, extra limb or duplicate accessory. Entire body including both ear tips and both soles inside clear transparent margins, facing screen-right in three-quarter game view. One character, true transparent RGBA, no background, floor, cast shadow, glow, text, logo, watermark or effects. POSE: COMBAT STANCE. A low alert but upright guard, knees gently bent, feet separated diagonally, empty left fist raised before chest, right prop hand lowered beside hip, eyes looking toward screen-right.

observations: Garde distincte, genoux fléchis et poing gauche levé ; accessoire dans la main droite abaissée.
Deux boutons, une poche, deux oreilles, deux jambes et deux pieds entiers ; design et couleurs conformes à la sélection approuvée.
